resources.string: At most once a day, when battery settings may delay scheduled messages
Open Settings → Apps → voice2sms → Battery and allow background use
To send scheduled messages on time, voice2sms needs to be allowed to run in the background: set its battery use to Unrestricted.
If voice2sms is force-stopped, it stays stopped, even after a reboot, until you open it again. Scheduled messages cannot go out until then.
On this Samsung phone, also add voice2sms to Battery → Never sleeping apps.
